summary: Grandstand Limited (formerly Gambling.com Group) filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, furnishing a press release reporting Q2 2026 financial results and reiterating full-year guidance. The filing discloses revenue of $37.8 million, adjusted EBITDA of $7.7 million, a net loss of $4.6 million, and adjusted free cash flow of $9.6 million. It also mentions a May 2026 restructuring, the Rollcard fintech launch, and a corporate rebrand. No M&A, tender offer, spin-off, or other special-situation event is present; this is a routine earnings announcement.
